pitch: Tokyo and Kyoto for the first-time visitors, then the Japanese Alps, which are new to you two. One night in a mountain temple, and the trip ends in Osaka.
warn: One long travel day (Fuji to Takayama)

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.how: Land at Haneda or Narita. Base in Asakusa or Ningyōchō (quieter, central).
highlights: Asakusa's Sensō-ji early, then the old Yanaka neighbourhood
Tsukiji outer market breakfast; depachika crawl at Mitsukoshi Nihonbashi
Sunset over Fuji from Shibuya Sky (winter air is clear)
Christmas Eve lights; a day in Kamakura or Nikkō for your parents
stops.eat: Sushi counter lunch, monjayaki in Tsukishima, Ebisu Yokochō izakaya
stops.bump: Large stations involve a lot of walking. Two taxis (GO app) fit six people

stops.name: Lake Kawaguchiko
stops.how: Fuji Excursion limited express from Shinjuku, ~2 h.
highlights: Christmas at Fuji, with morning views from the north shore
Oshino Hakkai spring village; Saiko Iyashi-no-Sato thatched village
Chūreitō Pagoda for those who want the climb
stops.eat: Hōtō miso noodle hotpot, Yoshida udon
stops.bump: Book a Fuji-view room with a private bath

stops.name: Takayama
stops.how: Train to Matsumoto (stop for the castle and lunch), then bus to Takayama. About 5–6 h, the longest travel day.
highlights: Miyagawa morning market and Sanmachi merchant streets
Sake brewery tastings (amazake for her)
Hida Folk Village under snow; the festival float hall
stops.eat: Hida beef sushi, hoba-miso, mitarashi dango

stops.name: Shirakawa-go → Kanazawa
stops.how: Nōhi bus with a 2–3 h stop in Shirakawa-go, then continue to Kanazawa.
highlights: Gasshō farmhouses in the snow
Kenroku-en garden, with ropes supporting the pine branches against snow
Higashi Chaya geisha teahouses; gold-leaf workshop
stops.eat: Snow crab and nodoguro at Ōmichō market (you leave before it closes for New Year)

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.how: Shinkansen to Tsuruga + Thunderbird, ~2 h 15. 30 Dec is a peak day, so book as soon as seats go on sale.
highlights: Nishiki Market on 30 Dec, when people shop for New Year
New Year's Eve at the large bell of Chion-in, then the Okera-mairi fire at Yasaka Shrine
1 Jan osechi breakfast; 2 Jan early hatsumōde at Fushimi Inari (lower gates)
3 Jan karuta-hajime; tea ceremony; Arashiyama; day trip to Uji
stops.eat: Kaiseki lunch, yudōfu, obanzai home cooking
stops.bump: Rent a whole machiya for six people, with a living room and kitchen

stops.name: Kōyasan
stops.how: Nankai line from Osaka plus cable car, ~3 h from Kyoto.
highlights: Lantern walk through Okunoin's forest cemetery at dusk
Dawn chanting and goma fire ritual with the monks
stops.bump: Temperatures are below freezing and corridors are cold. Choose a temple with heated rooms

stops.name: Osaka
stops.how: ~1.5 h down the mountain. Fly out of Kansai on 9 Jan.
highlights: Dōtonbori and Kuromon for the parents
Day trip to Nara: deer and the Great Buddha
Day trip to Himeji Castle or Kobe beef lunch
Sakai knife-forging workshop
stops.eat: Kushikatsu in Shinsekai, takoyaki, a proper Osaka kappō counter

pitch: More ryokan nights and more snow than the other routes. One night in a thatched gasshō farmhouse and a quiet New Year in Takayama. Kyoto and Osaka come after the holiday, when shops and museums have reopened.

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.how: Land and base in Asakusa or Ningyōchō.
highlights: Asakusa, Yanaka, Tsukiji outer market
A depachika crawl and Shibuya at night
stops.eat: Sushi, yakitori under the tracks in Yūrakuchō

stops.name: Lake Kawaguchiko
stops.how: Fuji Excursion from Shinjuku, ~2 h.
highlights: Fuji at dawn; Oshino Hakkai
Christmas Eve at a ryokan

stops.name: Yudanaka / Shibu Onsen
stops.how: Back via Tokyo and the Hokuriku shinkansen to Nagano, then local train. ~4–5 h.
highlights: Jigokudani snow monkeys, reached by a 30-minute forest path each way (flat but icy)
Shibu Onsen's lantern-lit street and its nine public baths
Zenkō-ji temple and its dark underground passage
Chestnut sweets and the Hokusai museum in Obuse
stops.bump: She can decide on the day whether to walk to the monkeys. The town and Zenkō-ji are easy

stops.name: Kanazawa
stops.how: Nagano → Kanazawa by shinkansen, ~1 h.
highlights: Kenroku-en in snow; Higashi Chaya teahouses
Nagamachi samurai lanes; 21st Century Museum
stops.eat: Snow crab at Ōmichō, Kanazawa oden

stops.name: Shirakawa-go
stops.how: Bus, ~75 min.
highlights: Stay in a gasshō farmhouse inn (minshuku) with dinner by the hearth and futon beds
A quiet evening in the village after day visitors leave
stops.bump: Baths are shared and stairs are steep. Ask for a ground-floor room

stops.name: Takayama
stops.how: Bus, ~50 min.
highlights: Toshikoshi soba on New Year's Eve and midnight at a local shrine
New Year's Day osechi at the ryokan
Sanmachi streets and sake breweries

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.how: 1 Jan is a quiet travel day. Hida express to Nagoya, then shinkansen, about 3.5 h.
highlights: Early-morning hatsumōde at Fushimi Inari on 2 Jan
Karuta-hajime at Yasaka on 3 Jan
Tea ceremony, Arashiyama, Kinkaku-ji in winter light
stops.eat: Kaiseki lunch; Nishiki Market stalls reopen in early January

stops.name: Osaka
stops.how: ~15 min. Fly out of Kansai.
highlights: Nara and Himeji day trips
Dōtonbori, Kuromon, Shinsekai

pitch: Milder weather and the least walking of the four routes. It visits Hiroshima and Miyajima, spends New Year in a Yufuin ryokan with a private onsen, and ends in Nagasaki and Fukuoka. You fly home from Fukuoka.

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.how: Land and base centrally.
highlights: Asakusa, Yanaka, Tsukiji, depachika

stops.name: Hakone
stops.how: Romancecar from Shinjuku, ~85 min.
highlights: The Hakone loop by mountain train, ropeway over the sulphur vents and boat on Lake Ashi
Fuji across the lake on clear mornings
Open-Air Museum
stops.eat: Black eggs at Ōwakudani; kaiseki at the ryokan

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.how: Shinkansen from Odawara, ~2 h. Sit on the E side for Fuji.
highlights: Kiyomizu-dera, Gion and Arashiyama, before New Year closures
Tea ceremony and kimono for your parents
Nara day trip

stops.name: Miyajima & Hiroshima
stops.how: Shinkansen, ~1 h 40. 29 Dec is a peak day, so book early.
highlights: Stay on Miyajima overnight and see the torii gate lit up at night
Peace Memorial Park and museum

stops.name: Yufuin
stops.how: Shinkansen to Hakata, then the Yufuin no Mori train, about 4 h. Trains are quieter on 31 Dec.
highlights: New Year's Eve in a ryokan with its own open-air bath
Morning mist on Kinrin Lake
Day trip to Beppu for the hot-spring 'hells' and steam-cooked food
stops.bump: Many Yufuin inns have private onsen baths

stops.name: Nagasaki
stops.how: Via Hakata and the Nishi-Kyūshū shinkansen, ~4 h.
highlights: Dejima Dutch trading post; Glover Garden
Peace Park; night view from Inasayama ropeway
Chinatown

stops.name: Fukuoka
stops.how: ~1.5 h. Fly home from Fukuoka.
highlights: Dazaifu Tenmangū shrine
Kotatsu boat ride on Yanagawa's canals
Karatsu or Arita pottery towns
stops.eat: Hakata ramen, motsunabe, mentaiko, yatai stalls, winter fugu

pitch: Almost all of this route is new to you two. A rented van takes you to an Edo-period post town, Ise Jingū, the Kumano pilgrimage area and Kōyasan for New Year's Eve at a temple. Kyoto and Osaka come at the end for the first-time visitors.

stops.name: Tokyo
stops.how: Land and base centrally.
highlights: Asakusa, Yanaka, Tsukiji, a day in Kamakura

stops.name: Lake Kawaguchiko
stops.how: Fuji Excursion, ~2 h. Pick up a 10-seat van on 25 Dec.
highlights: Fuji at dawn; Oshino Hakkai
Chūreitō for the active four

stops.name: Tsumago (Kiso Valley)
stops.how: Drive ~3 h.
highlights: Walk the Nakasendō trail from Magome to Tsumago, 8 km
The others explore Magome and drive the van to Tsumago
Lanterns on the post-town street at night

stops.name: Ise
stops.how: Drive ~3.5 h via Nagoya.
highlights: Ise Jingū's outer and inner shrines, on flat gravel paths among old cedars
Oharai-machi pilgrim street
Meoto Iwa wedded rocks at sunrise
stops.eat: Akafuku mochi, Ise udon, Matsusaka beef, spiny lobster
stops.bump: You visit a few days before the New Year crowds

stops.name: Kawayu Onsen (Kumano)
stops.how: Drive ~3 h.
highlights: Sennin-buro, a large bath dug into the riverbed (winter only)
Kumano Hongū Taisha and the giant torii at Ōyunohara
Kumano Kodō from Hosshinmon to Hongū, 7 km. She can walk the last section
Nachi Falls (drive to the top, skip the stone stairs)
Tsuboyu, a small UNESCO-listed bath booked in 30-minute slots
stops.bump: Sennin-buro is shallow and cooler at the edges

stops.name: Kōyasan
stops.how: Drive ~4 h on mountain roads; winter tyres essential.
highlights: New Year's Eve temple bells; Kōyasan has more than 100 temples
Dawn service on 1 Jan; Okunoin lantern walk
stops.eat: Shōjin ryōri, New Year temple food
stops.bump: These are the coldest nights of the trip. Choose heated rooms

stops.name: Kyoto
stops.how: Drop the van in Osaka or Kyoto (one-way fee), ~2.5 h.
highlights: Fushimi Inari, Kiyomizu, Gion, Arashiyama
Karuta-hajime on 3 Jan; tea ceremony
stops.eat: Kaiseki lunch, Nishiki as it reopens

stops.name: Osaka
stops.how: ~15 min. Fly out of Kansai.
highlights: Nara day trip
Dōtonbori, Kuromon, Shinsekai
